name: crypto-risk
description: Risk Manager: PASS or BLOCK for every ticket against the user's limits, before anything can be sent: stop required, loss per trade, daily loss limit, trades per day, reward:risk, max leverage, max notional, stop beyond the liquidation estimate, margin vs account, entry window, blocked symbols, duplicates, real mode off. Getting out is never blocked by a day limit. Use when the user says "check my order", "is this safe", "risk check", "can I take this trade", and always before the broker.
